verdict.rationale: Docs show Microsoft Graph API provides broad programmatic access mirroring many UI capabilities (user CRUD, SCIM provisioning, app management, diagnostics), suggesting substantial API/UI parity for admins and AI-native tooling. However, there is no explicit claim of full parity, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the docs domain, which undercuts easy AI-native API discovery/automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 100% API/UI feature parity, a published OpenAPI/swagger spec for self-describing API access, and independent confirmation that all UI-only settings (e.g., some Conditional Access or governance policies) are also API-configurable.
